answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral, then treats coordinated equivocation as one correlated fault: if k identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty scales as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling escrow. Thus a tundra of aliases cannot hide coordination; the vine of shared funding is exposed through the trellis of attestations, making swarm expansion economically irrational.
